title: Entrance Exam Calendar 2026-27
intro_short: The exams that matter most after Class 12 — application windows, exam dates and official websites, each clearly labelled so no expected date is mistaken for an official one.
intro_full: This calendar covers the major entrance and recruitment examinations for the 2026-27 season, in one place. Every entry shows what is happening (application window, exam date, result timing) and carries one of three labels: CONFIRMED means an official notification or exam calendar has announced it; EXPECTED means it is projected from the previous cycle and can still change; NOT ANNOUNCED means no official date exists yet. The calendar is refreshed twice a week (Monday and Thursday) from official sources — NTA, UPSC, SSC, RRB, CBSE, ICAI and state boards. Use it to plan applications, not as a substitute for the official notification.

sections.heading: Apply now — urgent deadlines
sections.body: Application windows that are open or closing in the coming weeks. Check the official website before the last date.

items.title: CLAT 2027 (Consortium of NLUs)
items.body: Application window is open for the Common Law Admission Test. The exam is a two-hour paper held in the afternoon.
items.meta: Apply by 31 Oct 2026 | Exam 6 Dec 2026 | CONFIRMED (official)

items.title: JEE Main 2027 (Session 1) — registration
items.body: NTA opened Session 1 registration on 24 October 2026. Late fee window 23-26 November, correction 27-29 November, city intimation slip 30 December, admit card 13 January 2027. This is the single biggest deadline for Class 12 science students this quarter.
items.meta: Apply by 22 Nov 2026 | Exam 20-24 & 28 Jan 2027 | CONFIRMED (official, NTA notice 24 Oct 2026)

items.title: BPSC TRE 4.0 (Bihar school teacher) — 33,320 posts
items.body: Bihar Public Service Commission extended the window on 26 October: fee payment until 2 November and the online form until 3 November 2026. Advertisement 15/2026; exam date not yet announced.
items.meta: Apply by 3 Nov 2026 | Exam NOT ANNOUNCED | CONFIRMED (official, BPSC)

items.title: KRDP Combined Recruitment 2026-27 — 12,878 posts
items.body: Khadi Reform and Development Programme (MSME Ministry) Group B and Group C posts: 10th, 12th, graduation, B.Com, B.E./B.Tech or Master's depending on the post. Two-step process: registration 26 October-25 November, final submission 26-30 November, correction 2-4 December. No application fee for any category.
items.meta: Register by 25 Nov 2026 | Exam date TBA | CONFIRMED (official, portal.krdp.org.in)

items.title: RRB NTPC 2026 (Graduate and Undergraduate)
items.body: Two separate application windows for graduate and undergraduate posts, as per the official indicative notice.
items.meta: Graduate: 8 Oct – 6 Nov 2026 | UG: 15 Oct – 13 Nov 2026 | CONFIRMED (official notice)

items.title: UGC NET December 2026 cycle
items.body: Application window is open and was extended on 27 October 2026 to 31 October (11:50 PM) with no late fee. Correction window 2-4 November, exam city slip 23 November, admit card 7 December.
items.meta: Apply by 31 Oct 2026 | Exam 14-18 & 21 Dec 2026 | CONFIRMED (official)

items.title: CTET 2026 (CBSE, 22nd edition)
items.body: The Central Teacher Eligibility Test will be held over two days. Applications for this cycle are already closed.
items.meta: Exam 12–13 Dec 2026 | CONFIRMED (official)

items.title: NDA (I) and CDS (I) 2027 (UPSC)
items.body: Notification and application window for the first NDA and CDS exams of 2027, per the UPSC calendar.
items.meta: Apply 2–22 Dec 2026 | Exam 11 Apr 2027 | CONFIRMED (UPSC calendar)

items.title: CA Foundation, January 2027 cycle
items.body: Exam form window opens in November, with a late-fee window; the exam runs over four days in early January.
items.meta: Form: 3–16 Nov 2026 | Exam: 3, 5, 7, 9 Jan 2027 | CONFIRMED (official)

items.title: UPSSSC PET 2026
items.body: Preliminary Eligibility Test for Uttar Pradesh government posts, held in two shifts per day on the revised schedule.
items.meta: Exam 25 Oct, 30 Oct and 1 Nov 2026 | CONFIRMED (official, revised)

items.title: CAT 2026 (IIM Indore)
items.body: The Common Admission Test for MBA admissions. Registration for this cycle has closed.
items.meta: Exam 29 Nov 2026 | CONFIRMED (official)

sections.heading: After Class 12 — Medical and Engineering
sections.body: The two biggest streams after Class 12. NEET UG 2027 will shift to a computer-based test — an officially announced change.

items.title: NEET UG 2027
items.body: The exam date is not announced. NTA's revised calendar (26 October 2026) does not list NEET UG. The reported plan to move NEET UG to a computer-based test from 2027 is still under consideration - the Centre told the Supreme Court on 18 September 2026 that no final decision has been taken, and a parliamentary panel on 9 October 2026 only recommended the shift. Early May 2027 is an estimate from the previous cycle, not an official date.
items.meta: Notification and exam date NOT ANNOUNCED (early May 2027 is an estimate) | CBT shift NOT ANNOUNCED (under consideration)

items.title: JEE Main 2027 (Session 1)
items.body: Registration is open from 24 October to 22 November 2026 (11:50 PM); late fee until 26 November, correction 27-29 November. NTA revised the exam dates on 26 October to 20, 21, 22, 23, 24 and 28 January 2027.
items.meta: Apply by 22 Nov 2026 | Exam 20-24 & 28 Jan 2027 | CONFIRMED (NTA notice 24 Oct, revised calendar 26 Oct 2026)

items.title: JEE Main 2027 (Session 2)
items.body: NTA's revised calendar (26 October 2026) gives Session 2 its first firm dates: 2 to 7 April 2027. Registration window is expected after Session 1.
items.meta: Exam 2-7 Apr 2027 | CONFIRMED (NTA revised calendar, 26 Oct 2026) | Registration NOT ANNOUNCED

items.title: JEE Advanced 2027
items.body: Open to the top JEE Main qualifiers. The official schedule is expected around December 2026; press reports point to mid-May 2027 but treat any specific date as indicative.
items.meta: Schedule EXPECTED Dec 2026 | Exam mid-May 2027 (indicative)

items.title: UP NEET UG 2026 counselling — Round 3
items.body: Uttar Pradesh DGME notice ME-3/2026/1890 dated 26 October 2026: registration closed 28 October, merit list 28 October, choice filling 28 October-31 October (5 PM), seat allotment 2 November, admission 3-7 November. This is for the 85% state quota seats in UP medical and dental colleges.
items.meta: Choice filling closes 31 Oct 2026 (5 PM) | CONFIRMED (official, DGME UP notice 26 Oct 2026)

sections.heading: After Class 12 — Law, Management and Defence
sections.body: Law, business and defence entries beyond the science streams.

items.title: CLAT 2027
items.body: National law entrance for the 22 National Law Universities and several private law schools.
items.meta: Apply by 31 Oct 2026 | Exam 6 Dec 2026 | CONFIRMED (official)

items.title: CAT 2026
items.body: Gateway to the IIMs and most top MBA programmes. Registration closed on 22 September 2026.
items.meta: Exam 29 Nov 2026 | CONFIRMED (official)

items.title: NDA and CDS (I) 2027
items.body: Defence entry after Class 12 (NDA) and after graduation (CDS), conducted by UPSC.
items.meta: Apply 2–22 Dec 2026 | Exam 11 Apr 2027 | CONFIRMED (UPSC calendar)

sections.heading: Teaching and government jobs
sections.body: Recruitment examinations for teaching and central or state government posts.

items.title: CTET 2026
items.body: Eligibility test for teaching in central government schools; required by many state recruitment boards too.
items.meta: Exam 12–13 Dec 2026 | CONFIRMED (official)

items.title: UGC NET (December 2026)
items.body: Qualifies candidates for assistant professor and junior research fellowship roles. Application window open, extended on 27 October to 31 October (11:50 PM) with no late fee; correction 2-4 November; exam over 14-18 and 21 December 2026.
items.meta: Apply by 31 Oct 2026 | Exam 14-18 & 21 Dec 2026 | CONFIRMED (official, NTA notice 27 Oct 2026)

items.title: SSC CGL 2026
items.body: Combined Graduate Level examination for central government posts. Tier-1 is being held in this window; Tier-2 is expected in December.
items.meta: Tier-1: 30 Sep – 30 Oct 2026 (CONFIRMED) | Tier-2: Dec 2026 (EXPECTED)

items.title: SSC CHSL 2026
items.body: For 10+2 level central government posts. The Tier-1 window has been notified; exact shift dates appear on the admit card.
items.meta: Tier-1: 30 Nov – 31 Dec 2026 | CONFIRMED (official)

items.title: SSC JE and SSC CPO 2026 — revised exam dates
items.body: SSC corrigendum dated 26 October 2026 revised both schedules. Junior Engineer Paper-I (CBE) is now in two windows: 2-6 November 2026 and 30 November-1 December 2026 (Telecom and IMD Scientific Assistant papers in the second). Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and CAPF (CPO) is now 23-28 November 2026, from 20-28 November earlier.
items.meta: JE Paper-I 2-6 Nov & 30 Nov-1 Dec 2026 | CPO 23-28 Nov 2026 | CONFIRMED (official, SSC corrigendum 26 Oct 2026)

items.title: RRB NTPC 2026
items.body: Railway recruitment for graduate and undergraduate posts across zones. Exam dates are not yet announced.
items.meta: Apply Oct–Nov 2026 | Exam NOT ANNOUNCED

items.title: UPSSSC PET 2026
items.body: Preliminary test that qualifies candidates for a wide range of Uttar Pradesh government recruitments.
items.meta: Exam 25 Oct, 30 Oct and 1 Nov 2026 | CONFIRMED (official)

sections.heading: How to read the labels
sections.body: Every date in this calendar carries one of three labels. Please treat them differently.

items.title: CONFIRMED
items.body: Announced by the conducting body — NTA, UPSC, SSC, RRB, CBSE, ICAI or a state board — in an official notification or exam calendar. Note that NTA and UPSC calendars carry the caveat that dates are tentative and can be altered.
items.meta: Trust, but re-check at notification

items.title: EXPECTED
items.body: Projected from the previous cycle's pattern. Useful for planning, but it is not a promise and can shift.
items.meta: Plan, don't commit

items.title: NOT ANNOUNCED
items.body: No official date exists yet. Any specific date circulating on social media or coaching pages should not be treated as fact.
items.meta: Wait for the official notification

items.title: Refreshed twice a week
items.body: This calendar is updated from official sources every Monday and Thursday. If you are reading it on a later date, verify the current position on the official website before applying.
items.meta: Check the official website before applying
